name: Takashima Zakuro
source:
[url=https://vndb.org/c3565]Yuki[/url]'s schoolmate from a neighbouring class, Zakuro, is the protagonist of the "Looking-glass Insects" chapter. She has a tendency to get lost in her thoughts and frequently spaces out. Due to her timid and soft-spoken nature, [spoiler]she is often a target of tasteless pranks and bullying[/spoiler]. She considers her classmate [url=https://vndb.org/c3563]Kimika[/url] to be her only friend, though their relationship appears to be occasionally ambiguous.

[Edited from [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wonderful_Everyday]Wikipedia[/url]]
